theme: licensed public dataset preparation and private-backup documentation
question: Can a public-only, owner-licensed reference dataset load and reproduce the frozen Helsinki benchmarks?
outcome: Revised 19 configurations, 2720 rows, 949 parent-matching images; 49 independent museum joins retained and 19 Lipi-only joins excluded. Both benchmarks and all reviewer checks pass; four incomplete/invalid prediction cases rejected. CFF schema and privacy pass. No upload or visibility change.
challenge: Lipi-only identifier joins, private upload-folder disclosures, incomplete confidence/section instructions, mixed edition/project rights and Windows cache length.
remedy: Independent catalogue facts only; owner CC0/Unlicense with edition CC BY; portable source labels and owner-only audit/checklist; embedded Image columns with single storage; explicit input validation and redirected immutable reviewer scripts.
retry_when: Owner confirms the public issues repository and private-store Hub terms; a private upload permits hosted checks before final visibility approval. Later verified rows require a separate rights/source audit.
